title: Fake Gotō: how a name becomes a weapon
subtitle: Narrative war · round one
intro: One sentence, reposted four times, grows teeth. What you can decide now is which card to play first.
closing: The spread chain hasn't stopped. It has only moved into someone else's hands and keeps growing.

rounds.label: Round one · setting the tone
rounds.prompt: A fake-Gotō account appears. You have a screenshot, the original post, and two groups already on fire. What do you put down first?

choices.label: Throw the "Ji camp is impersonating" screenshot into the group
choices.detail: Fastest, and dirtiest. The screenshot saves everyone the trouble of verifying.
choices.result: The screenshot outruns the original post. While the Ji camp denies it, the group is already looking for the next target.

choices.label: Have the Gotō camp verify the timestamp internally first
choices.detail: A step slower, but it turns "who forged it" into a checkable question.
choices.result: The check runs past the hottest two hours. The Ji camp deletes the post; the Gotō camp has the original timestamp.

choices.label: Post nothing and let both sides guess
choices.detail: No side, no responsibility. Silence grows its own explanations.
choices.result: Both groups start writing stories for your silence. No one is convinced and everyone waits for the next screenshot.

rounds.label: Round two · the fallout
rounds.prompt: A video cuts the original sentence into "targeted bombing of the od scene". The chain has left your hands. What now?

choices.label: Release the full original post with context
choices.detail: Give everyone back the half-sentence that was cut.
choices.result: The full version travels slowly, but for the first time the Ji camp can't answer with a single image.

choices.label: Make a counter-video with the same cutting method
choices.detail: An eye for an eye. Effective, and it makes the next one easier.
choices.result: The counter-video explodes. Both sides start using "they cut first" as a reason.

choices.label: Hand the spread chain to a third party to archive
choices.detail: Leave the battlefield and give the evidence to someone who won't fight.
choices.result: The third party takes the whole chain. It belongs to no side now, and it can no longer save anyone immediately.

reactions.screenshot: The Ji camp turns your screenshot into a "Gotō-camp purge" poster. The Gotō camp asks you: where's the original post?
reactions.verify: The Gotō camp pins the timestamp to the wall. The Ji camp demands you publish the whole verification log.
reactions.silence: Both groups start writing stories for your silence. No one knows which side you are on.
